project.name: Kennoway
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 9 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Bonnybank Inn and other full restaurants do not qualify for the café-led Eat category. The restricted community-use café is not presented as an ordinary daytime visitor café. Leven and wider Levenmouth attractions are not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Worth a Visit
touristAppeal.summary: Kennoway is a credible day-walk stop through its 48-acre den, Maiden Castle viewpoint, historic Causeway, Fife Pilgrim Way connection and two council-listed car parks. The normal tourist café search was negative, so restricted community catering and full restaurants do not pad the score.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access can work for responsible dog visits; venue-specific policies are recorded individually.

visitorHighlights.name: Kennoway Den
visitorHighlights.reason: A 48-acre wooded den with a burn, ancient woodland, glacial and industrial history, an old bridge and links to Maiden Castle.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Open public greenspace; check weather and path conditions.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Kennoway Den is separately assessed for visit depth, distinctiveness, presentation, journey worth, access reliability and evidence quality.

townGuide.characterTag: Historic Causeway village beside an ancient den
townGuide.headline: Kennoway Den and a boundary-correct visitor audit
townGuide.intro: Kennoway is a credible day-walk stop through its 48-acre den, Maiden Castle viewpoint, historic Causeway, Fife Pilgrim Way connection and two council-listed car parks. The normal tourist café search was negative, so restricted community catering and full restaurants do not pad the score.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Kennoway Den
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Check the linked current source before travelling; related attractions are scored separately from the town.

townGuide.visitorMood: A worthwhile researched stop with clearly stated practical limitations.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
